notes: s004 me is emptied under rule 59's redundant-negative principle: mete is itself a negative able to carry the whole English negation as 'neither', so nothing is left for the preceding negator. Giving 'neither' to me and emptying mete was the competing reading and was rejected because mete is the coordinating pair. A reference comparison will report this as a disagreement, and that report is not a correction.
peri tinon is a rule 35 portmanteau rather than noncompositional: '-of' answers to the preposition and 'where-' to the pronoun, so the unit stays aligned and heads on the pronominal s011.
s005 noountes carries the supplied 'though' under rule 86, a participle being a token that carries subordination.
